component.name: Tempo
component.summary: Fast, modern video editor for Linux

description.p: Tempo is a lightweight, responsive video editor designed for Linux. Built with Rust, GTK4, Libadwaita, and WGPU, Tempo brings DaVinci Resolve-inspired speed and workflow to modern desktop environments.

ul.li: High-performance timeline with ripple, roll, slip, and fast keyboard edits
Multi-track video and audio compositing with GPU acceleration
Proxy workflow for fluid playback on modest hardware
DaVinci Resolve Cut page keyboard shortcuts parity
WASM plugin architecture with safe memory sandboxing
CMX 3600 EDL and H.264 export workflows
